name: Sticky Sections Scale
description: Full-height cards stack as they scroll, each pinning at the top then scaling down, dimming and rounding its corners while the next card slides over, with image contrast easing in.
contents: Stack of sticky full-screen cards, each with counter, image, title and text
behavior: Each card pins to the top and scales down, dims and gains rounded corners while the next card covers it
Card images move from high to normal contrast as they scroll into view
Smooth scrolling through Lenis, skipped when reduced motion is preferred
Loader overlay hides once images have loaded
